chunks: The fourth is to direct yourself to every obligation upon you that you neglected, so that you may fulfill its right.

key_terms.ضَيَّعْتَهَا: You neglected or failed to perform
key_terms.فَرِيضَةٍ: An obligatory religious duty or commandment

ai.seo_question: What is the fourth condition for true repentance in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this fourth pillar of *istighfār* highlights the transition from mere verbal repentance to active rectification of *huquq Allah* (rights of God), such as missed prayers or fasting. Sharif al-Radi places this within a structured framework where spiritual purification requires not only seeking forgiveness but also restoring the specific obligations neglected due to heedlessness.
